lines_of_business: Health benefit plans administered by Cigna Companies; delegated vendor guidelines may be used in certain markets
sections_in_order: Coverage Policy (Catheter Ablation; Percutaneous approaches to occlude LAA; Cardiac Surgery-LAA Exclusion/Excision; Surgical Ablation)
criteria_location: Coverage Policy pp.2-3: LAA closure paragraph is about 12 lines in a 4-procedure policy; scoring footnote under it. Codes in Coding Information pp.3-5. 25 pages of background.
procedures_covered: Catheter ablation for AF (93656, 93657), repeat ablation, VOM ablation, esophageal cooling
Surgical LAA exclusion not with open cardiac surgery (33267, 33269) not MN

logic.top_level: pathways (one policy, several procedures; LAAC block is all-of)
logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Closing sentence: any other indication including hypertrophic cardiomyopathy is NOT medically necessary.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Repeat ablation rule exists for catheter ablation ('recurrent symptomatic atrial fibrillation'); none for LAAC.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: a contraindication to long-term oral anticoagulation due to a nonreversible cause (e.g., arteriovenous malformation (AVM) in intestine or brain that is not treatable, recurrent duodenal ulcer, recurrent falls when cause of falls is not felt to be treatable)
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Examples list; 'nonreversible' and 'not felt to be treatable' are judgements; no statement that other causes qualify.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: a moderate to high risk of stroke (CHA2DS2-VASc score ≥2*)
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Footnote lists components as 'age greater than or equal to 65' with no weights (2 points at 75), so the score is not computable from the policy text alone; it names the score but not the formula.

requirement_kinds.quote: using a U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved device

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: Each code group is headed 'Considered Medically Necessary when criteria in the applicable policy statements listed above are met' / NMN / EIU; 33340 maps to the LAAC statement. Dagger notes on 93656/93657.

external_dependencies.what: Related coverage resources and delegated vendors
external_dependencies.quote: In certain markets, delegated vendor guidelines may be used to support medical necessity and other coverage determinations.

external_dependencies.quote: The Society for Cardiovascular Angiography & Interventions and Heart Rhythm Society (SCAI/HRS, Goldsweig, et al., 2025) developed 8 evidence-based recommendations

definitions_that_change_meaning.definition_quote: Congestive heart failure, hypertension, age greater than or equal to 65, diabetes, stroke/transient ischemia attack/thromboembolism, vascular disease, sex category.

vague_terms.quote: moderate to high risk of stroke

extraction_hazards: One policy with four procedure families; LAAC criteria sit between catheter ablation and surgical ablation
Background tables of studies (SCAI/HRS recommendations table) look like criteria
Coverage Policy page break splits the LAA heading from its body
interesting_structures: Contraindication-to-anticoagulation requirement phrased with clinical examples
Explicit statement that hypertrophic cardiomyopathy indication is NMN

fit_to_tree.why: Two-leaf all-of with one score threshold; leaf two is a judgement with examples, and the score footnote lacks weights.
